clue.text: Food about which a vegetarian would complain

definitions.text: Food about which a vegetarian would complain

parts.words: Food about which a vegetarian would complain
parts.note: a meat a vegetarian would object to eating, and the same word is slang for a grumble, so the complaint is folded into the meal

explanation.surface: A diner who shuns meat grumbles about what is on the plate.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat from cattle is a food a vegetarian refuses, and as slang the same word means a grievance.

clue.text: Plant Regina found in marshy ground

indicators.note: the queen's letter is found inside the word for wet land, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a fen is low marshy ground, as in the East Anglian Fens
R stands for Regina, Latin for queen, as in ER

explanation.surface: A botanist spots something growing in a bog, named after a woman called Regina.
explanation.walkthrough: R (Regina, the queen, as in the royal cipher ER) goes inside FEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A bracken-like frond-bearing plant that reproduces by spores is a classic example of a non-flowering plant.

clue.text: Youth with a yen for a mistress

parts.note: a lad is a youth, a young man
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese currency, the yen

explanation.surface: A young man who longs for a woman of the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yen' looks like a longing; here it is the currency, abbreviated Y.
explanation.definitionFit: The mistress of a house is its lady, the woman in charge.

clue.text: Nothing in great endeavour exhibits prejudice

indicators.note: nothing is placed inside the phrase for a great effort, splitting it between its two words

parts.note: big means great
a try is an endeavour or attempt
O, the zero, stands for nothing

explanation.surface: A great effort that comes to nothing reveals an intolerant attitude.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exhibits' is a link word; the definition is just 'prejudice'.
explanation.definitionFit: Intolerance of people with other opinions or backgrounds is prejudice by another name.

clue.text: Writing materials from stand by eastern railway

parts.note: a station is a place where one stands, a post

explanation.surface: Paper and pens bought from a kiosk on an eastern railway line.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a station bookstall, but STATION is 'stand', a post one takes up.
explanation.definitionFit: Paper, envelopes and pens are the goods sold as writing materials.

clue.text: Demotion, for instance, admitted by one of the family

indicators.note: the example abbreviation is let in by the family member, so it sits inside that word

parts.note: a relation is a family member
EG, exempli gratia, means for instance

explanation.surface: A demotion is taken in good part by one relative.
explanation.walkthrough: In football, Britain's main sport, relegation is a club's drop to a lower division at season's end.
explanation.definitionFit: Being sent down to a lower rank or division is a demotion.

clue.text: Honestly, the goats are infertile

definitions.meaning: young goats are kids, so goats producing none are not kidding

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means 'seriously, truly'; read literally it says goats are bearing no young.

clue.text: Set teas are too filling

indicators.note: set as a verb means arrange, so these letters are placed in a new order

explanation.surface: A set afternoon tea leaves the diners overfull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set teas' reads as a fixed menu, but 'Set' tells you to rearrange TEAS.
explanation.definitionFit: To glut or satisfy to excess is what over-filling food does.

clue.text: More can be put in a pantry

definitions.meaning: there is still space left, as in a box not yet full
a room in a large house for storing preserves and drinks

explanation.surface: A larder still has space for further provisions.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as two words, the answer says there is space for more; as one hyphenated word it is the old household store room where cordials were distilled.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means space remains; the compound is a country-house store room for preserves, a kind of larder.

clue.text: Wish to be employed doing embroidery

parts.note: to fancy something is to wish for it
to work is to be employed

explanation.surface: Someone hopes to get a job doing needlework.
explanation.definitionFit: Decorative needlework, as opposed to plain sewing, includes embroidery.

clue.text: Firm, small lettuce

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: A crisp little head of salad.
explanation.definitionFit: Romaine is the tall crisp variety of lettuce, named after the Greek island.

clue.text: I translate into Greek

parts.note: the letter I rendered in the Greek alphabet becomes that alphabet's ninth letter

explanation.surface: A classicist puts a sentence about themselves into Greek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I' looks like the speaker, but it is the letter I, whose Greek counterpart is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The ninth Greek letter corresponds to our I.

clue.text: In civil litigation it is deleterious

indicators.note: the answer is found in the letters running across the two words

explanation.surface: Going to court over a civil case does harm.
explanation.definitionFit: Harmful or bad for health is the shared sense, as in ill effects.

clue.text: Beauty queen must feel nostalgia for the secular life

parts.note: to miss something is to long for it after it has gone
the world, as opposed to the cloister or church, is secular life

explanation.surface: A nun who longs for life outside the convent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the world' in church usage means life outside religious orders.
explanation.definitionFit: The title goes to the winner of an international beauty pageant.

clue.text: Union instigator responsible for many a strike

definitions.meaning: someone who arranges a marriage, a union of two people
a maker of the sticks that are struck to light a fire

explanation.definitionFit: A matrimonial go-between arranges unions; a factory worker producing lights struck on a box makes the same word.

clue.text: Suddenly appear when summer comes

definitions.meaning: to leap into view without warning
by summer the season of spring is over, out and gone

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means jump into sight; read literally, spring is out once the next season arrives.

clue.text: Whale meat cooked in flour

indicators.note: cooking changes ingredients, so these letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Whale flesh is prepared in a coating of milled grain.
explanation.definitionFit: Brown flour milled from wheat with some bran left in is a kind of flour.

clue.text: Celebrity placing £1 bet

parts.note: the pound sign is L (libra) and the one is I, the Roman numeral
a bet is on when placed, as in 'the bet is on'

explanation.surface: Someone famous puts a pound on a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: L comes from libra, the Latin behind the pound sign.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary or social lion is a much-courted famous person.

clue.text: Set out to feature Maggie's predecessor

parts.note: to star is to feature prominently
Ted Heath led the Conservatives before Margaret Thatcher

explanation.surface: Someone sets about featuring a former prime minister.
explanation.walkthrough: Maggie is Margaret Thatcher; Ted Heath was the Conservative leader she replaced in 1975.
explanation.definitionFit: To begin a journey or task is to set out.

clue.text: So let it be construed as an understatement

indicators.note: construing means interpreting, so these letters are taken in a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A speaker shrugs that a remark should be read as an understatement.
explanation.definitionFit: The figure of speech affirming something by denying its opposite, 'not bad', is a form of understatement.

clue.text: Get wrinkled with time-the result of heredity?

parts.note: a face lines as wrinkles appear
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Aging skin is a family trait passed down the generations.
explanation.definitionFit: Descent from ancestors, one's family line, is what heredity passes along.

clue.text: Avoid getting hot in bright light

indicators.note: the letter for hot goes inside the word for bright light

parts.note: the sun gives bright light
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Staying out of the heat of strong sunshine.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep away from something is to shun it.

clue.text: What's-his-name is scrawny and tacky

parts.note: thin means scrawny
gummy means sticky, tacky

explanation.surface: Someone whose name is forgotten is described as skinny and sticky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tacky' looks like 'tasteless', but here it means sticky.
explanation.definitionFit: A placeholder word for a person or thing whose name escapes you.

clue.text: Part of the journey made by vessel

indicators.note: only a portion of the words is taken, the run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: A stage of a trip made by boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessel' suggests a ship, but it is a container.
explanation.definitionFit: A large vase or tea urn is a container, a vessel.

clue.text: Margaret returned with treasure

indicators.note: turned back, so the short name is read from right to left

parts.note: Meg is a pet form of Margaret

explanation.surface: Margaret comes home bearing riches.
explanation.definitionFit: A precious stone, or a person much valued, is a treasure.

clue.text: Thanks military boss for Mexican food

parts.note: ta is British slang for thank you
CO is a Commanding Officer

explanation.surface: Grateful to the commander for a Mexican meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A folded tortilla with a filling is a Mexican dish.

clue.text: Teams awarded points during tea-break

parts.note: cricket and football sides have eleven players each, so teams are elevens
E and S are compass points, east and south

explanation.surface: Sides are given scores during a mid-morning pause.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the answer is a light snack and drink taken around 11am.
explanation.definitionFit: The mid-morning snack or drink is a British break for tea.

clue.text: Initially it has a foot in each trading bloc

definitions.text: Initially it has a foot in each trading bloc

parts.words: Initially it has a foot in each trading bloc
parts.note: the group is known by its initials, and its member countries span both European trading groups as an alternative to the Common Market

explanation.surface: A country keeps one foot in each of two economic groups.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the initials of the European Free Trade Association.
explanation.definitionFit: The European Free Trade Association is an economic grouping, known by its initials.

clue.text: Indubitable hesitation by America is upsetting

indicators.note: in a down clue upsetting turns the letters upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: er is a hesitation
US is America

explanation.surface: Doubtless America's dithering is disturbing.
explanation.walkthrough: ER + US, read upwards, as this is a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Certain and beyond doubt is the meaning shared.

clue.text: Appear to understand a Frenchman

parts.note: to see is to understand
M is short for monsieur, a Frenchman

explanation.surface: Seeming to grasp what a man from France says.
explanation.definitionFit: To look or give the impression is to appear.

clue.text: Appropriate for a hunting party

definitions.meaning: fitting or proper, an old-fashioned adjective
the gathering of riders and hounds before a hunt

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means fitting; as a noun, a gathering of fox-hunters and hounds.

clue.text: A shade naive

definitions.meaning: green means inexperienced, and light suggests barely formed

explanation.definitionFit: The pale colour is a shade; green also means inexperienced, so the phrase suggests naivety.
